name: Atemoya 제휴 게시 outbox Telegram 전달

parameters.query: WITH owner AS (SELECT chat_id FROM public.telegram_owner_actors WHERE enabled ORDER BY added_at LIMIT 1), todo AS (SELECT o.id FROM affiliate.outbox o WHERE o.state='pending' AND o.kind='direct_affiliate_published' AND o.next_attempt_at<=now() AND o.attempts<5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM owner) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), claimed AS (UPDATE affiliate.outbox o SET attempts=o.attempts+1,next_attempt_at=now()+interval '30 minutes' FROM todo WHERE o.id=todo.id RETURNING o.id,o.event_key,o.payload) SELECT (SELECT chat_id FROM owner) AS chat_id, string_agg(id::text,',' ORDER BY id) AS ids_csv, count(*) AS event_count, left(string_agg('• '||COALESCE(payload->>'url',event_key),E'\n' ORDER BY id),3500) AS links FROM claimed HAVING count(*)>0;
UPDATE affiliate.outbox SET state='sent',sent_at=now() WHERE state='pending' AND id=ANY(string_to_array($1::text,',')::bigint[]) RETURNING id,event_key,state,sent_at;
